artworks.title: Marie Leszczynska of Poland, Queen of France
artworks.artist: Laurent Cars after Carle Van Loo
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body in a portrait. She is facing forward in an ornate oval frame. The woman has a serene expression, soft cheeks, defined eyebrows, and styled hair with curls and an ornament. She wears a richly decorated dress with lace sleeves, a cloak, and intricate embroidery. Earrings dangle from her ears. In the background, there is a plain backdrop, an engraved oval frame with text, and a decorative element with a crown and laurel wreath.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after Federico Zuccaro
artworks.description: The image depicts two female figures dressed in elaborate garments from the waist up. The taller person stands to the right, her body facing forward but her head turned slightly towards the viewer. Her facial features are delicate, with a slightly elongated face, soft eyes, and a composed expression. Her hair is styled upwards and adorned with decorative elements. She wears a high-necked dress with a prominently ruffled collar and sleeves, and intricate lace cuffs extending from her sleeves. The shorter figure stands to her left, with her body slightly turned towards the taller person. Her facial features are youthful, with a round face and alert eyes. Her hair is similarly styled, with curls framing her face. She wears a detailed gown with an elaborate floral design and a similar ruffled collar. This figure holds a flower in her right hand and a small bag in her left. The background features an opulent interior setting, with a leaded glass window offering a view of a distant building and a vase with a flower arrangement on a tabletop beside elaborate drapery. The floor is adorned with an intricate patterned design.

artworks.title: Phillip II of Spain
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Wierix
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.8 x 23.2 cm (12 1/8 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man. He faces the viewer in an upright posture. He has a full beard and mustache, giving him an aged appearance. His eyes are large and expressive, and he has a high forehead. He wears a tall, cylindrical hat with vertical stripes. He wears a fur-collared garment over a doublet with buttons, along with a ruffled collar. He has a chain around his neck with an ornament. The background has a simple, textured pattern.

artworks.title: Peter the Great of Russia
artworks.artist: Louis-Pierre Henriquel after Paul Delaroche
artworks.description: The image portrays a man in a military uniform, facing slightly to the right. He has prominent facial features, curly hair, and is holding a sword in his left hand, while the right hand rests on a large map. In the background, there is a faint image of a structure against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man standing in a three-quarter view, with his face turned slightly to the right. The man has distinct facial features, short hair, and is wearing a hat with a small floral decoration. He is dressed in a textured coat with a fur collar. The portrait is framed with floral and fruit motifs, including cherubs blowing trumpets. An inscription is visible below the portrait. The background is plain, emphasizing the details in the portrait and frame.

artworks.title: Maria Anna of Spain
artworks.artist: Jacob Louis after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a person seated in a forward-facing position. The person has a composed facial expression with finely arched eyebrows, a slender nose, and delicate lips. Their hair is styled in a short, curly manner, forming neatly around the head. They are dressed in an elaborate garment featuring a large, ornate ruff collar and a richly decorated bodice adorned with pearls and intricate patterns. The figure wears an elaborate jeweled headpiece and a prominent medallion that hangs at the center of the chest, surrounded by layered strands of pearls. The background consists of a decorative frame with intricate floral and leaf motifs, creating an opulent border around the portrait.

artworks.title: Maria of Burgundy, Empress and Wife of Maximilian I
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a woman facing slightly to the right, with a full view of her face. She has an oval face shape, defined cheekbones, a sharp nose, and large eyes looking in the same direction. She wears an ornate headpiece with decorative patterns and a lacy edge. Her clothing appears rich, possibly a gown with pearls and intricate embroidery, and she wears a cross pendant. The portrait is framed with floral and ornamental designs, including carvings and floral motifs. The background features detailed floral garlands and drapery. A medallion with a coat of arms is above her head within the decorative elements encircling her portrait.

artworks.title: Marie Therese of Spain, Dauphine of France
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Jean-Baptiste Van Loo
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in an elaborate 18th-century gown with lace and embroidery details. She is standing in a regal setting with architectural elements, a piece of furniture with a crown, and a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Mary I Stuart
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the chest up, turned slightly to her left with her face towards the viewer. She has an oval-shaped face, large eyes, and a small mouth. Her long, wavy hair is parted in the middle and falls over her shoulders with a band across the top. She wears a garment with a lace collar and a pearl necklace. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with cherubs and intricate details. Above the frame is a coat of arms and below is a line of text, set against a plain background.

artworks.title: King George II
artworks.artist: Pieter Stevens van Gunst
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, positioned in a three-quarter view. He has a composed expression with prominent features, including a distinct nose and a defined jawline. His long, curly hair cascades past his shoulders. He is wearing intricately detailed armor beneath a luxurious cape with a fur trim, held together by a clasp at the shoulder. The scene is framed by a lavish drapery with ornate designs. The background is darkened to highlight the subject, and below the portrait, there is a decorative blank cartouche framed by elaborate foliage patterns.

artworks.title: Oliver Cromwell
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after Robert Walker
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a suit of armor, holding a baton, against a plain background.

artworks.title: Henry VII and the Family of Henry VIII in Whitehall Palace
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing around a large sculpted pedestal inscribed with text. On the left, a man stands confidently with one arm akimbo and the other resting on his hip, wearing elaborate regal clothing and a crown. The second figure, a tall man standing behind the pedestal, wears a long robe with a cap. The two women on the right are dressed elegantly in detailed gowns. The background is adorned with architectural elements, including columns, arches, and panels with sculpted cherubs. A small dog is seen at the bottom right, beside the woman in the foreground.

artworks.title: Lady Jane Grey
artworks.artist: George Vertue
artworks.description: This image features a circular portrait of a woman in a classical setting. The woman in the portrait wears a crown and an elaborate gown with a fur collar. The portrait shows her face and part of her upper body. Flanking the portrait are two large Corinthian columns adorned with flower garlands. Below the portrait, there is a regal cloak with a scepter and a crown. To the right of the portrait, a woman is seated, holding a shield or symbol. The background has ornate patterns, classical urns emitting smoke, and intricate architectural elements and text.

artworks.title: Charles I of England and the Duke of Hamilton
artworks.artist: Sir Robert Strange
artworks.description: Three men and a horse in an outdoor setting. The main figure stands, turned to the left, smiling. He wears a large-brimmed hat with a feather, long curly hair, a narrow mustache, goatee, decorated doublet, knee-high boots, and a short cape. He holds a walking stick and has a sword at his waist. To his left, a man leads a horse. The third figure, partially obscured, is a young man or boy. The background is a lush landscape with trees and hills under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Augustus Stellingwerf, First Lord Admiral of Friesland
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Lodewyk van der Helst
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man wearing a detailed outfit. He has a mustache and long hair, and is holding a cylindrical object and a hat. The background shows a maritime scene with ships on the water under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Arctic Hare
artworks.artist: John James Audubon
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and graphite with watercolor and oil paint on paper
artworks.description: Two rabbits, one white and one gray, lie on a grassy hill in this horizontal painting on paper. On our left, the white rabbit rests so its front paws face us, and it looks slightly off to our left. To our right, the gray rabbit takes up most of the picture with its head near the white rabbit and its tail nearly touching the right edge of the paper. Tiny pen and graphite strokes make up the individual hairs of the rabbits' fur and whiskers. The ground close to us is olive and earth green. Mountains are frosty teal-green in the distance under lavender-gray clouds streaking up and to our left against a blue sky. Two birds fly in the deep distance. Tiny writing in black ink in the top left corner spells "Leach" in the top left corner. A number 1 appears next to the gray rabbit’s head and a number 2 next to the white.

artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Attributed to Joshua Master
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures surrounding a central figure lying on a bed. The scene is encapsulated within an elaborately decorated initial letter Q, adorned with intricate floral patterns. The background features rich gold leaf, enhancing the illuminated manuscript style. Each figure is painted with luminous colors, holds books open, and gazes towards the central reclining figure, who is haloed and dressed in vivid blue and red robes. Above the scene, a crowned celestial figure is depicted within a round medallion, set against a starry background. This artwork is reminiscent of illuminated manuscripts from the medieval period.

artworks.title: Doubting Thomas
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 6.8 x 5.5 cm (2 11/16 x 2 3/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: Two figures with halos are depicted inside an architectural setting. The scene implies a religious or biblical theme, possibly influenced by medieval illuminations or early Christian art. The figures are situated within a structure featuring arches or vaulted ceilings, indicating a sacred location. The painting utilizes a limited color palette with earth tones and strong outlines, lending it an expressive, icon-like quality. Both figures wear halos, symbolizing divinity or sanctity, and are the central focus of the artwork. This artwork reflects the style of Byzantine art.

artworks.title: The Three Holy Women at the Tomb
artworks.artist: First Master of the Cortona Antiphonaries
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page. The manuscript page contains a detailed initial letter set within a square blue background, and it features a biblical scene involving multiple figures dressed in draped garments. The scene is surrounded by decorative elements, vibrant colors such as blues, reds, and golds, and intricate patterns. Additionally, there are sections of sheet music with square note notations and Latin script. The style resembles medieval illuminated manuscripts, possibly from the Gothic period.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.artist: Hans Baldung Grien
artworks.description: The image shows a man falling from a horse against a background of a cityscape, hills, and clouds with divine figures. The artwork is done in a woodcut style with fine lines and detailed etching. The man looks surprised, the horse is rearing, and a town with figures and buildings is visible in the distance. The color palette is monochrome, rendered in shades of sepia.

artworks.title: High-Class
artworks.artist: Ernst Barlach
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a public space. The scene depicts an environment with architectural elements such as stone or brick walls and steps. On the left, a figure cloaked in a draped garment crouches forward holding a small object or piece of paper in their hand, extended towards the second figure. The right side of the drawing features another figure standing on steps, turned slightly towards the first figure, with their arms folded or clasped behind their back. The setting is detailed with cross-hatching and shading techniques that give depth to the textures of stone and fabric.

artworks.title: Two Galleys behind an Armed Three-Master with Phaethon and Jupiter in the Sky
artworks.artist: possibly by Cornelis Cort after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of wooden sailing ships on the water, with waves and additional ships in the distance. Above the ships, dynamic cloud formations swirl across the sky. One cloud formation resembles a chariot led by horses emerging from a radiant figure in the sky. The etching exhibits detailed line work and cross-hatching for texture on both the sea and sky. The color palette is limited to black and white, emphasizing contrasts and creating a dramatic composition.

artworks.title: Armed Four-Master Sailing towards a Port
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a large sailing ship viewed from a low, rear angle. The ship's towering masts and sails dominate the scene as it rides atop the waves. Fine lines detail the water, and additional ships and a coastal landscape are visible in the distance. The sky is filled with large clouds, drawn with hatching and cross-hatching techniques. The color palette is monochrome, creating contrast between the ship and the sky and sea.

artworks.title: Armed Three-Master Anchored near a City
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a large ship at sea, seen from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line cuts across the ship, with historical buildings and fortifications in the background under a cloudy sky. The ship is intricately detailed in fine etching, with precise lines outlining its structure and sails. The sea is depicted with horizontal lines indicating movement. The color scheme is predominantly sepia, giving the image a historical feel. A small rowing boat with people is near the ship, providing scale. Additional smaller vessels and birds are also present in the scene.
